text:
[Council File 24-1137-S1]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Not Been Held - (10 Votes Required for Consideration)]
PUBLIC SAFETY AND BUDGET AND FINANCE COMMITTEES’ REPORT relative to the acceptance of Standard Agreement No. A231012696-A2 granted by the California Governor’s Office of Emergency Services for Swift Water/Flood Search and Rescue Training.
Recommendations for Council action, SUBJECT TO THE APPROVAL OF THE MAYOR:
1. AUTHORIZE the Fire Chief, or designee, to accept Standard Agreement No. A231012696-A2 in the amount of $182,310, for the performance period of May 22, 2024 through June 30, 2028, as granted by the California Governor’s Office of Emergency Services (Cal OES), and AUTHORIZE the Fire Chief, or designee, to execute any documents or agreements necessary to accept the agreement on the City’s behalf, subject to the approval of the City Attorney as to form.
2. AUTHORIZE the Los Angeles Fire Department (LAFD) to:
a. Deposit the receipt of the Standard Agreement funds into Fund No. 335/38, account to be determined.
b. Expend funds up to an amount of $182,310 from Fund No. 100/38, in various accounts such as Account 006020 (Operating Supplies) for consumables and student certification fees; Accounts 001012 (Salaries Sworn), 001090 (Overtime General), 001098 (Overtime Variable Staffing), and 002130 (Travel), in accordance with Cal OES Urban Search and Rescue Training, for the performance period granted by Cal OES; and AUTHORIZE the Fire Chief, or designee, to execute any documents necessary to accept the award on the City’s behalf.
c. Prepare Controller instructions as necessary to implement Mayor and Council intentions, subject to the approval of the City Administrative Officer (CAO), and AUTHORIZE the Controller to implement the instructions.
3. AUTHORIZE the Controller, for reimbursement purposes, to transfer the Standard Agreement funds from Fund No. 335/38, Account to be determined, to the following Fund No. 100/38 accounts: 001012 (Salaries Sworn), 001090 (Overtime General), 001098 (Overtime Variable Staffing), 002130 (Travel), and 006020 (Operating Supplies), upon submission of proper documentation by the LAFD of direct staff costs incurred during the performance period stated in the agreement.
Fiscal Impact Statement:
The CAO reports that approval of the recommendations will not have an impact on the General Fund. Anticipated expenditures totaling $182,310, as provided by the Swift Water Training Agreement with Cal OES, will be front-funded by the LAFD and subsequently fully reimbursed by Cal OES upon receipt of expenditures.
Financial policies The CAO reports that the recommendations comply with the City’s Financial Policies statement in that all Agreement funding will be utilized for its intended purposes.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
